headline: Bradesco Loan Book Tops BRL 1.1 Trillion as Regional Lenders Report Q3
summary: Banco Bradesco grew its loan portfolio past BRL 1.1 trillion with digital clients reaching 45 million in Q3, while U.S. regional bank First Western posted an 88% surge in net income.
why: Bank earnings and loan portfolio expansions reflect credit demand and asset quality across emerging and developed markets.

impacts.name: Banco Bradesco
impacts.why: Expansion of the loan portfolio and digital customer base strengthens retail interest and fee income.
